$comment: AUTHORED DATA, not derived. Read by tools/build-content.ts.
Every power in the workbook's `Power List` sheet is single-target, hostile and
non-reactive unless it appears here. The workbook has no column for any of the
three, so this file carries what `resources/mechanics/03-powers.md` states
explicitly, cross-checked against every power's `Prompt` text.
MOST BUFFS ARE NOT FRIENDLY, and that is correct rather than an oversight.
About twenty powers grant a buff, but in every case bar one the buff is a
RIDER ON AN ATTACK and lands on the caster -- 'Might x3.5 single-target
Earth/Dark strike; Ossic also raises a wall of bone around himself'. The power
targets an enemy. Marking it friendly would make the engine aim a damaging
strike at an ally, so `friendly` tracks WHO THE POWER TARGETS and never
whether a buff happens to result.
Provenance:
targets  -> 03-powers.md 'Multi-target powers' + each power's Prompt text
friendly -> the three heals in 03-powers.md 'Healing', plus Whisper from
the High Reach, which is the roster's ONLY ally-targeting
non-heal: 'No direct damage. Grants the whole squad a temporary
Speed and Agility buff.'
KNOWN LIMIT: `friendly` is a boolean and The Unhidden Hour touches both sides
-- it cleanses the whole squad AND strips every enemy's buffs. It is recorded
as hostile because the contested half is the part that needs resolving against
a defender. A power that genuinely needs both wants a third value, not a lie.
This file should disappear. The right home for all of it is three new columns
in `Power List`, at which point the reader drops the overlay entirely.
$noDamageComment: 03-powers.md: 'Three powers deal neither damage nor healing -- Whisper from
the High Reach, The Unhidden Hour, The Undoing. Their multiplier cell is
BLANK, NOT ZERO: zero would read as "deals no damage", when the truth is that
damage is not a thing these powers have.'
The workbook disagrees. All three carry multiplier 5, the tier-5 default,
which says each deals Might x5. That is a live content bug, not a doc
mismatch: a sim reading it would have three tier-5 powers dealing full damage
that are specified to deal none.
